caption: The drawing consists of a single, bold black shape on an off-white background. The shape is composed of thick, straight and curved black lines forming a geometric structure. At the top of the vertical line, two curved lines extend to the left and right, each ending in horizontal bars; the left curve arcs downward and then outward, while the right curve arcs upward and then outward, both giving a symmetrical appearance at the top of the figure.
